name: Controller Command Pad
description: Quick customizable command buttons for A, B, X, Y, triggers, and emergency stop.
author: Tavros Baker
code:
const root=document.querySelector('#xp-plugin-'+"tavros.controller-command-pad"+' .xp-workshop-content');if(!root)throw Error('Plugin panel missing');root.innerHTML="

Ready

";const buttons=root.querySelector('[data-buttons]');for(const key of ['A','B','X','Y','LB','RB','LT','RT','UP','DOWN','LEFT','RIGHT']){const b=document.createElement('button');b.textContent=key;b.onclick=async()=>{try{await xlink.command('press '+key+' 100');root.querySelector('[data-result]').textContent='Sent '+key}catch(e){root.querySelector('[data-result]').textContent=e.message}};buttons.append(b)}const stop=document.createElement('button');stop.textContent='STOP';stop.onclick=()=>xlink.stop();buttons.append(stop);return()=>root.replaceChildren();
